text.tspan: Event 5, MVA-only group. MW is power drawn from the Primary. Black: actual. Blue line: forecast median.
Blue band: 5% to 95% interval. Grey band: the labelled event. From the start onwards: the run 37.0 hours
before the start; earlier half-hours: the run 24 hours before each (the latest earlier run if none).
Events not in the label table may also be present.
